materials.description: Charred residue left by fire.
materials.name: Soot

materials.description: Choking fumes from burning reagents.
materials.name: Smoke

materials.description: Clear, thin and cheap — the base of most brews. The village well refills it for free.
materials.name: Crag Brook Water

materials.description: Slick and golden; it will not mix with watery liquids and floats on top of them. Burns readily.
materials.name: Willow Pressing

materials.description: Thick, heavy and sweet. Sinks through watery liquids and flows reluctantly unless warmed.
materials.name: Marigold Syrup

materials.description: A light, volatile spirit. Blends with water, evaporates well below water’s boiling point and is flammable.
materials.name: Mintwort Brandywine

materials.description: A vividly coloured essence. Mixes freely with watery liquids and stains the whole brew.
materials.name: Barrow Essence

materials.description: A vividly coloured essence. Mixes freely with watery liquids and stains the whole brew.
materials.name: Jadeleaf Infusion

materials.description: A fine dry meal that piles like sand. Knead it with a watery liquid and it becomes a dough; add more liquid and it thins to a paste.
materials.name: Sunpetal Meal

materials.description: Glittering crystals that dissolve into watery liquids — faster when hot or stirred — making them denser.
materials.name: Thorn Brine Salt

materials.description: A vividly coloured essence. Mixes freely with watery liquids and stains the whole brew.
materials.name: Brinedeep Tincture

materials.description: Warm, faintly glowing grit. Reacts eagerly and catches fire if overheated in open air.
materials.name: Crag Ember Dust

materials.description: Chunks of everlasting rime kept at -30°C. They melt into icy water, chilling the brew — or crush them first.
materials.name: Mistral Winter Gem

materials.description: A heavy, mirror-bright liquid metal. Mixes with nothing and sinks beneath every other liquid.
materials.name: Gloam Liquid Pewter

materials.description: Hard luminous shards. Crush them with the pestle; the grains slowly dissolve into spirits.
materials.name: Moonstone

materials.description: Waxy flakes that melt into an oily liquid when warmed and set into a solid cake when cooled.
materials.name: Willow Wax Flakes

materials.description: An effervescent powder. Dissolved together with a certain essence it fizzes, releasing a heavy vapour.
materials.name: Vale Effervescent Dust

materials.description: Softly glowing spores; light enough to float on water until kneaded in.
materials.name: Tidewater Glowcap Spores

materials.description: Blood-red resin lumps. They soften into a very thick, oily liquid only when properly heated.
materials.name: Cinnabar Sap of Ages

materials.description: Bottled starlight that glimmers in the dark. Prized by mages.
materials.name: Azure Comet Dew

materials.description: Dried troll moss. Binds into a tough green paste that toughens the drinker.
materials.name: Mintwort Ironwort

materials.description: A heavy marsh gas that pools low. It condenses into a liquid if the brew is chilled near freezing.
materials.name: Mintwort Swamp Vapour

materials.description: Ash that is still warm a century later. It reacts violently with water.
materials.name: Marigold Sunbird Cinders

materials.description: Ink darker than night. It refuses to mix with water or oil and settles in its own layer.
materials.name: Mandrake Abyssal Tar

materials.description: A restorative elixir created by dissolving salt into a vital essence and heating it.
materials.name: Fernwater Restorative

materials.description: A fiery cordial that warms from the inside out.
materials.name: Nightshade Ardent Draught

materials.description: A glimmering tincture of dissolved moonlight, sought by scholars and wizards.
materials.name: Willow Mystic Essence

materials.description: A dense, protective salve baked from dough and syrup.
materials.name: Nightshade Fortifying Salve

materials.description: The heavy bubbles released by a fizzing reaction.
materials.name: Fizz Vapour

materials.description: What remains after a fizz.
materials.name: Spent Salts

materials.description: Syrup darkened by fierce heat into a deep, warming caramel.
materials.name: Cinnabar Toffee Draught

materials.description: The legendary cure-all: vitality and arcana in perfect union.
materials.name: Emerald Cure-all

materials.description: Liquid metal infused with crystal — heavy, shining and protective.
materials.name: Nightshade Silvered Alloy

materials.description: A blazing brew of rebirth. Dangerous to make, wondrous to drink.
materials.name: Jadeleaf Rebirth Draught

materials.description: A thick protective varnish of melted resin and oil.
materials.name: Cinnabar Varnish

materials.description: An icy bloom of crystal patterns suspended in liquid. Only forms in the cold.
materials.name: Azure Winter Philtre

materials.description: Liquid light. It glows bright enough to read by.
materials.name: Mistral Starglow Serum

materials.description: A knotted woodland root that carries strength. Crush or grind it; it gives up far more when steeped in hot water.
materials.name: Old Ironroot

materials.description: Soft silvery leaves prized by healers. Grind them into water; gentle warmth draws out their healing.
materials.name: Dew Silverleaf

materials.description: A poisonous leaf, gathered at dusk. Its oily extract dissolves in spirits rather than water. Test tiny doses before you trust it.
materials.name: Moon Nightshade

materials.description: A rare screaming root of transformation. Old grimoires say it wakes fully only in warm spirits.
materials.name: Ember Mandrake

materials.description: Soft meadow petals carrying affection. Warm water draws their love into an infusion; strong heat spoils them.
materials.name: Raven Heartpetal

materials.description: A prickly golden flower that warms the blood. It brews into a fiery tea.
materials.name: Dusk Sunthistle

materials.description: A rare blue clover, open only at dawn, that brings vivid dreams and clear insight.
materials.name: Ember Dreamclover

materials.description: Soft alkaline chalk from the bank. It neutralises acids. Ground and stirred into water it clouds into chalk milk; a little water kneads it into a paste.
materials.name: Star River Chalk

materials.description: A cool mushroom growing beneath the willows. It steeps only in ice-cold water, giving a freezing brine.
materials.name: Thorn Frostcap

materials.description: A marsh bean: restorative, though a little poisonous unless something cancels its bite.
materials.name: Hollow Bogbean

materials.description: A warm flint that releases fire when ground. It barely dissolves unless the water is near boiling.
materials.name: Raven Ember Flint

materials.description: Naturally loose glittering grains. Knead with a little water for dough; warm plenty of water with it for a shimmering infusion.
materials.name: Frost Mica Dust

materials.description: A crumbly yellow crust. Strongly acidic, it etches stone and stings flesh. Hot water dissolves it into a biting acid.
materials.name: Hollow Sulphur Crust

materials.description: Glass struck by lightning. It still holds a charge that flows into anything that conducts.
materials.name: Ember Storm Glass

materials.description: Moss from old barrows, heavy with death magic, scraped at dusk. It steeps only in near-freezing water. Dilute generously and test carefully.
materials.name: Star Grave Moss

materials.description: A luminous crystal of love and insight. Crush it, then warm it in spirits.
materials.name: Hollow Star Quartz

materials.description: A faintly glowing lichen that the wisps feed on. Lukewarm water draws out its light.
materials.name: Raven Wisp Lichen

materials.description: A furious red pepper from the crags. Its fire loves oil.
materials.name: Raven Dragon Pepper

materials.description: A shed salamander scale, warm to the touch. Only fierce heat — hot oil, not water — dissolves it.
materials.name: Moss Cinder Scale

materials.description: A dark root extract: all of the root’s strength, fully in solution.
materials.name: Steeped Old Ironroot

materials.description: A pale, fragrant healing infusion.
materials.name: Dew Silverleaf Infusion

materials.description: Scorched petals: the love is gone and bitterness remains.
materials.name: Wilted Raven Heartpetal

materials.description: The waking root dissolved in warm spirit.
materials.name: Ember Mandrake Tincture

materials.description: Crushed quartz dissolved in warm spirit; it glimmers.
materials.name: Starlit Quartz Tincture

materials.description: Pepper fire carried in oil.
materials.name: Dragonfire Oil

materials.description: The neutral grit left where acid met chalk.
materials.name: Gypsum Grit

materials.description: The magic of Moon Nightshade drawn into spirit.
materials.name: Nightshade Tincture

materials.description: The magic of Raven Heartpetal drawn into water.
materials.name: Heartpetal Infusion

materials.description: The magic of Dusk Sunthistle drawn into water.
materials.name: Sunthistle Tea

materials.description: The magic of Ember Dreamclover drawn into water.
materials.name: Dreamclover Tea

materials.description: The magic of Star River Chalk drawn into water.
materials.name: Chalk Milk

materials.description: The magic of Thorn Frostcap drawn into water.
materials.name: Frostcap Brine

materials.description: The magic of Hollow Bogbean drawn into water.
materials.name: Bogbean Broth

materials.description: The magic of Raven Ember Flint drawn into water.
materials.name: Flint Fire-Water

materials.description: The magic of Frost Mica Dust drawn into water.
materials.name: Mica Shimmer

materials.description: The magic of Hollow Sulphur Crust drawn into water.
materials.name: Sulphur Water

materials.description: The magic of Star Grave Moss drawn into water.
materials.name: Barrow Draught

materials.description: The magic of Raven Wisp Lichen drawn into water.
materials.name: Lichen Glow

materials.description: The magic of Moss Cinder Scale drawn into oil.
materials.name: Salamander Essence

reactions.name: Fernwater Restorative
reactions.hint: Dissolve Thorn Brine Salt in Barrow Essence and keep it hot.

reactions.name: Nightshade Ardent Draught
reactions.hint: Crag Ember Dust reacts where it touches warm Jadeleaf Infusion. Stirring spreads the reaction.

reactions.name: Willow Mystic Essence
reactions.hint: Crush Moonstone and dissolve it in warm Mintwort Brandywine — but don't boil the spirit away.

reactions.name: Nightshade Fortifying Salve
reactions.hint: Knead Sunpetal Meal with Marigold Syrup into a dough, then bake it gently.

reactions.name: Effervescence
reactions.hint: Vale Effervescent Dust fizzes when dissolved into Jadeleaf Infusion. The bubbles make a brew lively and volatile.

reactions.name: Cinnabar Toffee Draught
reactions.hint: Heat Marigold Syrup far beyond boiling water and it darkens.

reactions.name: Emerald Cure-all
reactions.hint: Blend Fernwater Restorative with Willow Mystic Essence while warm, not hot.

reactions.name: Nightshade Silvered Alloy
reactions.hint: Gloam Liquid Pewter swallows crushed Moonstone wherever they touch.

reactions.name: Jadeleaf Rebirth Draught
reactions.hint: Marigold Sunbird Cinders reacts violently with Crag Brook Water — keep the heat under control.

reactions.name: Cinnabar Varnish
reactions.hint: Melt Cinnabar Sap of Ages into hot Willow Pressing.

reactions.name: Azure Winter Philtre
reactions.hint: Melted Mistral Winter Gem and Brinedeep Tincture combine only when kept near freezing.

reactions.name: Mistral Starglow Serum
reactions.hint: Tidewater Glowcap Spores bloom when kneaded into warm Azure Comet Dew.

reactions.name: Steeped Old Ironroot
reactions.hint: Ground Old Ironroot steeps into a liquid extract in hot water.

reactions.name: Dew Silverleaf Infusion
reactions.hint: Dew Silverleaf infuses in warm (not boiling) water.

reactions.name: Wilted Raven Heartpetal
reactions.hint: Strong heat spoils Raven Heartpetal.

reactions.name: Ember Mandrake Tincture
reactions.hint: Ember Mandrake wakes in warm spirit.

reactions.name: Starlit Quartz Tincture
reactions.hint: Crushed Hollow Star Quartz dissolves in warm spirit.

reactions.name: Dragonfire Oil
reactions.hint: Ground Raven Dragon Pepper pours its fire into warm oil.

reactions.name: Neutralisation
reactions.hint: Star River Chalk fizzes where it meets Hollow Sulphur Crust and both turn to neutral grit.

reactions.name: Nightshade Tincture
reactions.hint: Moon Nightshade dissolves in spirit between about 25 and 60°C.

reactions.name: Heartpetal Infusion
reactions.hint: Ground Raven Heartpetal steeps into water between about 30 and 60°C.

reactions.name: Sunthistle Tea
reactions.hint: Ground Dusk Sunthistle steeps into water between about 55 and 90°C.

reactions.name: Dreamclover Tea
reactions.hint: Ground Ember Dreamclover steeps into water between about 35 and 75°C.

reactions.name: Chalk Milk
reactions.hint: Ground Star River Chalk steeps into water only when chilled below 65°C.

reactions.name: Frostcap Brine
reactions.hint: Ground Thorn Frostcap steeps into water only when chilled below 15°C.

reactions.name: Bogbean Broth
reactions.hint: Ground Hollow Bogbean steeps into water between about 40 and 85°C.

reactions.name: Flint Fire-Water
reactions.hint: Ground Raven Ember Flint steeps into water between about 85 and 165°C.

reactions.name: Mica Shimmer
reactions.hint: Ground Frost Mica Dust steeps into water between about 40 and 90°C.

reactions.name: Sulphur Water
reactions.hint: Ground Hollow Sulphur Crust steeps into water between about 55 and 100°C.

reactions.name: Barrow Draught
reactions.hint: Ground Star Grave Moss steeps into water only when chilled below 10°C.

reactions.name: Lichen Glow
reactions.hint: Ground Raven Wisp Lichen steeps into water between about 20 and 55°C.

reactions.name: Salamander Essence
reactions.hint: Moss Cinder Scale dissolves in oil between about 145 and 310°C.

observations.text: It nuzzles your hand, utterly devoted.
